subject: Demo: Dedicated capacity for Finly — throughput & latency review
messages:
From: Jordan Patel <jordan@finly.co>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-28T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Interest in Dedicated demo for latency-sensitive inference

Hi Marissa,

We just signed up via the self-serve flow and evaluated Redwood's hosted API. We're interested in a dedicated deployment because we have strict throughput/latency requirements for our payments fraud model. Typical profile: ~70 inference requests/sec during peak windows, p95 latency target <150ms, and tight SLAs around availability.

Would like to schedule a demo of Dedicated capacity and understand sizing, autoscaling behavior, and what guarantees you can provide around latency. Attaching a short load summary for context.

Thanks,
Jordan Patel
Head of Data Infrastructure
Finly

Attachment: Finly-load-summary-20261028.pdf
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Jordan Patel <jordan@finly.co>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-28T18:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interest in Dedicated demo for latency-sensitive inference

Jordan —

Thanks for signing up and for the load summary — this is great context. I'd be happy to coordinate a Dedicated demo and loop in our Solutions Engineer, Aditya, to walk through throughput/latency sizing, kernel/quantization options, and autoscaling behavior.

Proposed 30–45 minute slots (Pacific time):
- Thu 2026-10-29 10:00–10:45 PT
- Thu 2026-10-29 14:00–14:45 PT
- Fri 2026-10-30 09:00–09:45 PT

If none of those work, tell me your availability and we can adapt. We'll cover: deployment topology options (single-tenant GPU pool vs multi-tenant burst), estimated GPU sizing for 70 req/s at target latency, and fallbacks/policies for graceful degradation.

I'll attach our Dedicated one-pager and a mutual action plan template so we can capture next steps/contacts.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
SDR | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Jordan / Sophie —

Thanks for confirming — we've scheduled Thu 2026-10-29 10:00–10:30 PT. Linking the meeting invite now. Quick note on the pre-demo questionnaire: could you provide the following before the session so we can prepare targeted sizing and a short benchmark?

1) Inference QPS profile: baseline vs peak (you mentioned ~70 req/s peak; what is baseline?)
2) Typical request payload size (avg tokens or bytes)
3) Required p50/p95 latency SLOs and acceptable tail latency
4) Expected concurrency (number of concurrent distinct sessions/users)
5) Any data residency/KMS/networking constraints (VPC, static egress IPs, allowed CIDR)

For reference, with a 70 req/s peak and p95 <150ms for a 2k-token model, we typically recommend a 4–8 GPU Dedicated pool (model & quantization dependent). We'll run a short micro-benchmark during the demo to show expected throughput/latency tradeoffs and explain autoscaling windows.

I'll prepare a short runbook and cost estimate for the provided profile; if you can upload answers to the mutual-action-plan spreadsheet before 9AM PT, we'll include concrete numbers in the demo.

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai
